heading.title: Central and State Advisory Boards on Disability and District Level Committee

article.title: Vacation of seats.
article.content: If a Member of the State Advisory Board becomes subject to any of the disqualifications specified in section 68 his seat shall become vacant.
article.html:
69Vacation of seats.

Section 69 · Chapter XI · page 25 of the Act

If a Member of the State Advisory Board becomes subject to any of the disqualifications specified in section 68 his seat shall become vacant.
